name: documents
description: 能力文档库检索工具（只读）。action=list 列出 ~/.moss/agent/documents 下的主题与文档；action=search 按关键词全文检索（返回 路径:行号）；action=read 读取指定文档（path 相对文档库根，如 browser/best-practices.md）。覆盖 browser / computer / ptc / terminal / subagent / memory / mcp / skills / context / safety 十个主题。遇到这些能力的具体接口、推荐流程、失败恢复与验收标准问题时，先检索再执行；文档以当轮工具 schema、用户指令与安全策略为准。
description_en: Read-only capability document library. action=list lists topics and documents under ~/.moss/agent/documents; action=search full-text searches by keyword (returns path:line); action=read reads a document (path relative to the library root, e.g. browser/best-practices.md). Covers ten topics: browser / computer / ptc / terminal / subagent / memory / mcp / skills / context / safety. Search these docs before acting on capability details, recommended flows, failure recovery, or acceptance criteria; the current tool schema, user instructions, and safety policy take precedence.

action.description: 操作类型：list=列出主题与文档；search=关键词检索；read=读取文档
action.description_en: Operation: list = list topics/documents; search = keyword search; read = read a document

topic.description: list：可选，仅列出指定主题（如 browser / computer / ptc）
topic.description_en: list: optional topic filter (e.g. browser / computer / ptc)

query.description: search：检索关键词（不区分大小写）

path.description: read：文档相对路径（如 browser/best-practices.md 或 INDEX.md）
path.description_en: read: document path relative to the library root (e.g. browser/best-practices.md or INDEX.md)
